tp4-ar.qualification: HICONC-TP4 Qwen checkpoint-index C64 rerun, 2026-10-04: paired and absolute teacher, three B64-versus-C32 decode repeats, full prefix equality, preemption bit identity, full GSM8K, bounded soak and performance passed with BF16 KV and text,image. Qualified through C64 for the frozen rerun implementation; later build identities require their own evidence. Not full production qualification.

tp4-mtp.qualification: Historical TP4 C1-C32 serving evidence; not full production qualification or qualification of later implementation identities. Speculation has workload-specific throughput regressions. Prefix matched-chunk exactness, frontier, drafter acceptance and 30-minute soak passed. Same-build GSM8K prefix-off/on was 196/196. HICONC-TP4 C64 gates passed on the pre-checkpoint-change build, but keep the default and qualified count at 32: 256-token GSM8K throughput fell from 1822 to 1692 tok/s and short outputs were flat; C64 TPOT matched AR, consistent with adaptive fallback. No C64 MTP rerun of the checkpoint-by-index implementation is claimed.

tp4-ar-dcp2.qualification: Experimental: tp4-ar at context-parallel size 2 (autoregressive: each sequence's K, V and QSA block keys split across the two ranks of a KV head's replica set), 43,496 pages per rank, 5,567,488 tokens. Served at 32 sequences; qual.dcp2.json's full cohort (plan step 45: teacher, long_context, spec_verify, verify_exact, prefix_exact, preemption_exact at concurrency 1 and determinism) passed on 2026-10-07. Not a release qualification: qual.json's other checks have not run at size 2.
